concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage table / plan.md Phase 8
concerns.text: Plan Phase 8.1 ('Record provenance, checksums, seeds in state/projects/...yaml', Constitution Principles I/III/V) has NO matching task. No task writes SHA-256 checksums of data/processed and data/results artifacts to the project state file, and no task pins/records the statsmodels seed. The coverage table lists only FR-001–FR-010/SC-001–SC-006 and omits plan Phase 8 entirely, so an implementer following tasks.md will never satisfy the plan's compliance/logging phase or the constitution's checksum requirement.
